$comment: Cannons and cannonballs (docs/CANNONS.md; owner, 2026-11-17, 2026-11-18). `cannons`: each a block (shared/blocks) whose Use fires it (block data `use: fire`): `ball` the ball it fires (a `balls` name), `muzzleSpeedMs` the ball's speed out of the barrel along the cannon's facing, `muzzleUpM` and `muzzleForwardM` where it leaves (m from the cannon's rear bottom cell's centre: up, and forward along the facing), `recoilShare` the share of the ball's momentum that pushes a body the cannon stands on back (0–1; its carriage and ropes take the rest: the whole of a 455 kg ball at 45 m/s sent a 12 t raft back at 1.7 m/s a shot), `reloadS` the least time between shots (0: none; owner, 2026-11-18: "set that to off or none, so you can fire quickly"). `balls`: each a block of look `ball` by `name`, `radiusM`, `densityKgM3` (steel 7,850: "a heavy steel ball"; owner 2026-11-18: "double the size", "8× mass, real steel"), `rollDamping` (its rolling resistance: its speed's damping, 1/s, while it touches the ground), and its `impact` (owner, 2026-11-18, one design replacing the knock and explosive balls): each breakable block its sphere runs into is destroyed while it moves at `destroySpeedMs` or more, the ball losing `energyPerKgJ` joules for each kg of the block ("by the block's weight"); slower than that the block is knocked loose as a physics block and the contact slows it. At each such hit the breakable cells within `dragRadiusM` of its centre come loose too (at most `maxLooseCells` a tick), and every loose piece within `dragRadiusM` of it is pushed along its velocity by `dragForcePerSpeedN` newtons for each m/s of its speed, every tick ("it should exert continuous force as it flies around it, in its velocity direction"); slower than `minSpeedMs` it does none of this. Prototype values. `helms` (C5; owner, 2026-11-17: "ship should be moveable with player controls, force should be exerted like a sail would, from the center of mass I think. Turning like you have a rudder"): each a block (with `use: helm`) a player takes the helm at; while the ship (a built body) is afloat, forward and back push it along the helm's facing from its centre of mass with a force of its mass × `thrustAccelMs2`, as a sail would (owner, 2026-11-18: "The movement force should be scaled based on the mass of the boat, so big boats can move at a reasonable speed too"), and left and right turn it as a rudder would, `turnRadS2PerMs` rad/s² of turn for each m/s it moves along its heading, whatever its size (owner, 2026-11-18: "a 3x3 rafter turns very quickly ... and a 7x7 raft turns super slowly. Perhaps it just needs to be scaled too?"), none when still. A helm's `camera` (owner, 2026-11-18: "The camera should smoothly transition to 3rd person when you grab the helm"): at the helm the view eases out over `easeS` seconds to `backM` behind the eye along the look and `upM` up, and back in when the player leaves it. A cannon's `fire` (owner, 2026-11-18: "We need sound effects and VFX for cannon fire"; "Flash + smoke puff", "A deep boom"): the looks of its shot at the muzzle, in the explosives' schema (shared/explosives `effects`: flash, smoke, dust, boom, shake); its sound is its block's sound set's `explode` (shared/sounds). `elevationDeg` (owner, 2026-11-18: "Cannon fire angle should be angled up a bit?"): the barrel's tilt up from level along its facing (naval guns were set by a wedge from about −5° to +10°). A helm's `wheel` (owner, 2026-11-18: "A spoked wheel model"): its look, drawn by the meshers for its block's look `wheel`: a post up to the hub `hubM` over the cell's floor, a rim of `radiusM` with `spokes` spokes running out `handleM` past it, the wheel across the helm's facing.
